`share-relay deploy` now waits (up to five minutes) for the host's sshd to answer before its first step, retrying only ssh's own exit 255 (no session established: connection refused, host-key rejection or authentication failure), never a failing remote command. `just provision-dev-relay` runs the deploy straight after the instance reports ACTIVE, and on 2026-09-12 the dev-josh-2 relay's sshd was not listening yet, so the recipe failed with "Connection refused" after the instance had been created and registered; the deploy, DNS and collector steps had to be re-run by hand.
